name: EventCard
description: Display a summary of an event including title, date, location and links.

context.description: The kebab-case or BEM element chain name of the parent component or variant (if contextually relevant).

detailUrl.description: The URL to be used for the detail page.

externalLink.description: An associative array with fields URL, label, and target for an external link to a separate ticketing, registration, or other third-party site.

location.description: The location of the event, such as the name of the venue or an address.

shortName.description: The name of the component without any namespacing, prefixes, etc. Used for BEM block/element naming. Derived from the Blade filename if not explicitly set.

tagName.description: The HTML tag to use for this component

testId.description: Optionally add a data-testid attribute for automated tests

innerComponents.description: Inner components to be rendered within this component
